name: 数据标注实训云
description: 面向教学实训的多模态数据标注工作台，支持自有素材、PDF 文字导入、预设实训项目和已保存项目续标。

composer.prompt: 数据标注通过右侧数据标注工作台使用。用户点击左侧“数据标注”或右侧控制台中的数据标注入口后，工作台会自动在 iframe 中打开，无需调用浏览器工具或展示本地带令牌地址。不要查找素材、索要路径或从对话创建标注任务。用户在工作台上传素材、输入文字、导入 PDF 或选择内置实训项目。仅在用户明确要求时调用 list-projects 和 get-project，只读查看已保存标注。

permissions.reason: 仅在本机 127.0.0.1 启动数据标注实训页面和标注接口。
加载用户在插件页面中上传并保存的图片和标注。
将标注结果保存到当前工作区的插件专属目录。

en.name: Data Annotation Training Cloud
en.description: A multimodal data annotation workbench for teaching and training, with user-owned media, PDF text import, prepared exercises, and resumable saved projects.

composer.prompt: Use Data Annotation in the right-side workspace app. The sidebar Data Annotation entry and the console launcher open the workbench automatically in an iframe. Do not use browser tools or expose token-bearing local URLs. Do not search for media, request paths, or create annotation tasks from chat. Users upload media, enter text, import PDF files, or select bundled exercises in the workbench. Only call list-projects or get-project when explicitly asked to inspect saved annotations; chat operations are read-only.

labelu-data-annotation-service.label: Data Annotation Training Service
labelu-data-annotation-service.description: Starts the independent multimodal workbench, extracts text from imported PDF files, and saves projects and annotations created in the workbench.

labelu-data-annotation-workflow.label: Data Annotation Training Workflow
labelu-data-annotation-workflow.description: Guides the Agent to open the multimodal workbench directly and inspect saved projects only when explicitly requested.
